title: Love and Hot Chicken by Mary Liza Hartong
description:
Novels & Nibbles is delivering quirky characters and delicious hot chicken with this novel. PJ Spoon leaves her Vanderbilt University PhD life in Nashville and heads back to the tiny Tennessee town (she swore she had outgrown) to comfort her mom after her daddy’s unexpected death. Between frying up hot chicken at The Chickie Shack, navigating small town shenanigans surrounding the Hot Chicken Pageant, and falling for a curly-haired singer/coworker, Boof, PJ serendipitously discovers that sometimes the road home leads to exactly where you are meant to be.

Mac & Cheese “Waffle” and Nashville Hot Chicken starts with creamy bacon-loaded mac & cheese studded with green onions pressed into a crispy golden “waffle” then crowned with juicy buttermilk-marinated Nashville Hot Chicken and crunchie pickles for the perfect sweet-meets-heat, crispy-meets-creamy bite.

It’s cheesy. It’s crunchy. It’s a little bit spicy. It’s worth leaving your house for! Hope to see you soon.
